command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_04/nodes').name; foreach(`$n in `$nodes){ foreach(`$c in @('display%20current-configuration','show%20running-config')){ `$a=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_04/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$c)).output; `$b=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork-for-perf_04/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$c)).output; if(`$a -ne `$b){ Write-Output ('===== '+`$n+' :: '+`$c+' ====='); Compare-Object (`$a -split \"`n\") (`$b -split \"`n\") | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Output } } }"
